description: This file is a Java source file for a Spring MVC controller named EventController. It handles HTTP requests related to creating new events, including displaying a form for a new event and processing the form submission to generate and save an event. The class interacts with services for authentication, client management, and event persistence.

classes.name: EventController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller managing event-related web requests, including creating new events.

methods.name: newEvent
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display a form for creating a new event, populating the form with an empty event object and a list of clients associated with the authenticated user.

methods.name: registerEvent
methods.description: Handles POST requests to process the new event form, parsing the date/time, associating the event with the authenticated user, saving it in the repository, and displaying the result page.
